caption: The video showcases a linear-motion test rig viewed from a high angle: two fixed wooden beams each carry a polished metal rod, and four blue bearing blocks tied to two wooden boards form a sliding carriage against a black frame with red knobs. The carriage drifts rightward along the rods to a rightmost position, then reverses and slides leftward to a leftmost rest position, then begins moving rightward. A left hand, its index finger extended, touches the near-left block at the start and withdraws, while a right hand enters from the lower right and rests on the near-right block. The left hand re-enters and hovers at the near-left block. The beams, rods and background frame remain in place as the carriage slides.
